# coder_workspace_ai_agent (Data Source)

Use this data source to fetch the workspace's AI agent identity. The session token is a scoped API key for the workspace's AI agent identity, sponsored by the workspace owner. Template authors decide where to inject it; typically it is passed to an AI tool or sandbox so the tool can authenticate to the Coder AI gateway, including its MCP endpoint. The token carries only the AI agent identity's restricted scopes, never the owner's full permissions.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The UUID of the workspace's AI agent identity.
- `session_token` (String, Sensitive) Scoped session token for the workspace's AI agent identity. It is regenerated every time the workspace is started. Empty when the deployment does not provision an AI agent identity for this workspace.
